long_biography.plain_text:
At the Museum of Modern Art, Philip S. Niarchos serves as a trustee, placing the Greek collector within the governance of a major public institution. He also co-leads the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, helping oversee grant-making across culture, education, health, sport and social welfare.

Niarchos's relationship with art has sometimes moved beyond ownership. After he commissioned a portrait, Andy Warhol used CAT-scan films of his head to create the Philip's Skull series. The resulting works turned the collector himself into the subject and remain a distinctive record of his friendship with Warhol.
